def.zh-tw: 由平衡的化學反應式計算反應物與生成物的量；反應式的係數是粒子數比，也是莫耳數比，質量要先換成莫耳數才能用係數比。
def.en: Working out the amounts of reactants and products from a balanced chemical equation; the coefficients are a particle ratio and a mole ratio, so masses must be turned into moles before the coefficient ratio is used.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：化學計量[法] stoichiometry

def.zh-tw: 反應物的量不剛好時，最先用完、因而決定生成物多少的那種反應物（選修化學內容）。
def.en: When the reactants are not in exact proportion, the reactant that runs out first and so decides how much product forms (elective chemistry).

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下化學名詞：限量試劑 limiting reagent
